problem: Surveys and interviews are slow and costly; simulated respondents let teams test scenarios at scale and validate against humans.
business_model: Open source library plus no-code web app, paid LLM access and hosted features (pricing not found)

technical_complexity.rationale: A Python domain specific language with caching and a remote service; hard parts are reproducibility and validity against humans.

defensibility.rationale: Open source code is copyable; academic credibility and a response cache could add some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: By 2026 funded synthetic respondent players exist (press reports Simile and Electric Twin rounds), per one roundup with inconsistent figures.

market_need_then: Synthetic respondents were a topic of research and vendor activity in 2024 and 2025 per a Research Live article and industry roundups, with skeptics noting validity limits.

branding.community_and_virality: Open source EDSL repository on GitHub; a Feb 2026 magazine feature covered the tool

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable animal name suggests recall, but I found no source on its meaning, a mascot or community size.

outcome_analysis: Expected Parrot is an active YC Fall 2025 company founded in 2024 by Robin Horton and John Horton, the latter an MIT Sloan economist per the YC page. Its open source library gives credibility with academics, which fits the founders' backgrounds. Funding is only seen in aggregators and the category has attracted large rounds elsewhere, so the open question is whether paid adoption follows.
